title: Traders pour cash into BlackRock’s India ETF as AI rout deepens
summary: Investors poured over $316 million into BlackRock’s iShares MSCI India ETF last week, its largest weekly inflow since June 2025, as AI-related volatility drove diversification away from technology-heavy markets. Strong Indian equities, lower oil prices and improving earnings boosted sentiment, while foreign investors increasingly reversed their bearish positioning.
